query: INSERT INTO metadata_versions (manifestation_id, source, field_name, new_value, value_hash, match_type, confidence_score, status, resolved_by, resolved_at) VALUES ($1, 'manual', $2, $3, $4, 'manual', 1.0, 'pending'::metadata_review_status, $5, now()) ON CONFLICT (manifestation_id, source, field_name, value_hash) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = now(), observation_count = metadata_versions.observation_count + 1, status = 'pending'::metadata_review_status, resolved_by = $5, resolved_at = now() RETURNING id
